chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn al-Sindi, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from al-Sharīs al-Wabashī, from Jabir, from Abū Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed, the scent of Paradise can be detected from a distance of five hundred years of travel, but the dutiful son (or one whose parents are displeased) and the cuckold will not find it. It was asked: 'O Messenger of God, who is the cuckold?' He replied: 'One whose wife commits adultery and he knows about it.'

key_terms.عَاقٌّ: Dutiful son (or one whose parents are pleased)

ai.seo_question: Who are the two people who will not smell the scent of Paradise according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, this hadith highlights the spiritual consequence of passive negligence in marital duty, where the 'āq (often interpreted as the one who neglects his parents' rights or is overly attached to worldly status) and the dayth (the man aware of his wife's infidelity but failing to act) are excluded from the sensory blessings of Paradise. This reflects the Shia emphasis on 'amr bi-l-ma'ruf wa-nahy 'an al-munkar' (enjoining good and forbidding evil) extending into the domestic sphere, where awareness without action is considered a spiritual deficiency.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 2-15 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ahmad ibn Idris quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ahmad, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Al-Sindy, on the authority of Ali ibn al-Hikam, on the authority of Muhammad ibn al-Fuzayl, on the authority of Sharis al-Vabeshy, on the authority of Jabir, on the authority of Abi Ja’far al-Baqir (MGB) that God’s Prophet (MGB) said,

“The scent of Paradise can be smelled from a distance of five-hundred years away. However, those damned by their parents and the cuckold will not sense it.” He was asked, “O Prophet of God! Who is a cuckold?” He (MGB) replied, “One whose wife commits adultery and he knows about it.”What Has Been Said About Two-Faced People
